sources.citation: StressTyp2 (StressTyp2.ullet.net) online and local 2015 SQL dump; Ethnologue (pym); HathiTrust full-text search; Google Books snippet search; OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar/Crossref/Internet Archive searches.
sources.note: StressTyp2 has no Fyem entry; Ethnologue, HathiTrust search, Google Books snippet view, ELP and Webonary are bot-blocked; Crossref returns nothing Fyem-specific; Internet Archive was offline. Google Books feed shows Nettle 1998 (id xFEbAQAAIAAJ) with no preview, and 1999 volumes of Afrika und Übersee and JALL that mention 'Fyem' (probably reviews/books received).

sources.citation: Blench, Roger. 2012. An Atlas of Nigerian Languages, 3rd ed., entry 132 'Fyem'.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Names (Pyam, Pyem, Paiem, Fem, Pem; Gyem), location (Jos, Barkin Ladi, Mangu LGAs), classification, and 'Grammars: Nettle (1998)'. Nothing on phonology.

sources.citation: Dryer, Matthew S. & Haspelmath, Martin (eds.). WALS Online, language Fyem (fye), feature 13A Tone = 'Simple tone system', source Nettle 1998.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Second-hand: Fyem coded as a simple (two-level) tone language after Nettle 1998. Stress features 14A/15A/16A/17A have no value for Fyem (404). Nothing on stress.
